name: Eilean Mòr Lighthouse Mystery
description: The 1900 disappearance of three lighthouse keepers from the Flannan Isles Lighthouse on Eilean Mòr in the Outer Hebrides, Scotland — most plausibly attributable to a rogue wave during a severe storm.

aliases.name: Disappearance of the Flannan Isles keepers

origin: Single location: Eilean Mòr (the largest of the Flannan Isles), about 32 km west of the Isle of Lewis in the Outer Hebrides of Scotland.
